categories/artifacts.json::/description: Unique items that can be found in the dungeons.
categories/keys.json::/description: How to craft keys to new dungeons.
categories/portals.json::/description: How to build a portal to the dungeon dimension.
entries/advanced_keys.json::/pages/0/tex: While exploring dungeons you may rarely find $(item)portal keyhole blocks$(). These contain $(item)advanced portal keys$(), and this is the only way to find these keys. These keys open portals to dungeons that are TWICE as large with much higher quality loot!
entries/advanced_keys.json::/pages/1/tex: There are a few things you should know about these special keys. First, your portal will need an upgrade before they can be used. Second, the monsters inside will be much stronger and some difficult rooms may appear. You should be very well geared and prepared for an advanced dungeon!
entries/advanced_portals.json::/pages/0/: While exploring dungeons you may find $(item)portal keyhole blocks$(). These contain $(item)advanced portal keys$(). To use such a key you will need to upgrade your portal. The upgraded build requires two $(item)portal crown$() blocks, which can only be found in dungeon chests. You will also need two banners that are either purple or white.
entries/advanced_portals.json::/pages/1/: Then upgrade your portal like this.
entries/artifact_homeward_pearl.json::/p: The Homeward Pearl is a handy tool that will teleport you back to the entrance of the dungeon. It breaks after it is used.
Crafting Homeward Pearls is a good use for unwanted keys!
entries/artifact_key_charger.json::/page: You've found a portable $(bold)Key Enscribing Station!$() This block will allow you to activate blank portal keys the same as an End Portal Frame would. However, it may have a limited number of uses and can break.

The Key Enscribing Station has 3 states of damage just like an anvil. The odds of each use causing one level of damage is configurable, but by default the odds are 100%. Therefore a Key Enscribing Station can be used 3 times before it breaks.
You've created a key to your $(bold)own personal dimension!$() Your personal dimension is an 8x8 chunk space where you can build whatever you like! You could build a farm there, use it as a portable base, or take advantage of the flat area to make map art!

Don't worry if you lose the key to your personal dimension. All blank personal dimension keys that you activate will lead back to your dimension. And that is true for each other player in multiplayer as well.
entries/artifact_secret_bell_1.json::/pa: You've found a rare $(bold)Bell of Secrets!$() This bell will play a 2 note chime when rung. However, it will play an extended 8 note chime if there is a treasure chest or barrel nearby! Try ringing it in every room of a dungeon.

Due to the magical nature of the bell it only works in the dungeon dimension. The Bell of Secrets is strangely silent in all other dimensions.$(br2)For the technically inclined the blocks which will trigger the secret chime are determined by the block tag 'dimdungeons:dimdungeons_secret_chime_blocks'.
entries/artifact_secret_bell_2.json::/pa: You've found an upgraded $(k)Bell of Secrets$()! This bell functions just like the regular Bell of Secrets except that it also works in every dimension!
This item is unobtainable in version 1.13; but then again treasure from the future wouldn't be the strangest thing to find in a dimensional dungeon.
entries/artifact_teleporter_hub_key.json: You've found a key to a $(bold)Teleporter Hub!$() Each teleporter hub is technically a dungeon, but there are no mobs or treasure. Instead there is just one big open room with 8 doors leading to 8 portals. Each of those doors has its own key.

You are currently holding the key to the first of 8 doors. When you enter you'll be able to take the other 7 keys. Any portals you build with those keys will connect logically. Now you have the power to quickly travel great distances and even across dimensions at convenience!

Remember that portals to the dungeon dimension can be built in any dimension. You could use your keys to build a shortcut between your base, a stronghold, and the outer end islands. Each blank teleporter hub key that you find will lead to a new hub with seven different keys. All teleporter hub keys are unreplaceable so do not lose them!
entries/basic_keys.json::/pages/0/text: Once you have created your portal you will need a key, for which you will require: $(li)A Blaze Rod$(li)A Name Tag$(br)You will almost certainly want multiple keys, so you should craft as many as you can now.
entries/basic_keys.json::/pages/2/text: Blank keys cannot be used to enter a dungeon until they have been activated. Activating a key inscribes the name and location of a randomly generated dungeon on the key.$(br2)The activation ritual requires you to 'use' ($(k:use)) the $(item)blank key$() on the hole of an end portal frame. The end portal frame does not need to be part of a valid end portal.
entries/basic_keys.json::/pages/3/text: If all the end portal frames are occupied you can use the key to break the $(item)eye of ender$() in one of the frames. This does not break the portal to The End.$(br2)Once you have activated a key you can 'place' ($(k:use)) the key in the keyhole block of your portal build. 'Using' ($(k:use)) the keyhole of an active portal will remove the key and close the portal.
entries/basic_keys.json::/pages/4/text: Keys can only be activated and inscribed once; so you will need to craft and activate a new key for each new dungeon that you explore. But keys are not consumed by the keyhole and old keys can be reused to reopen portals leading back to the same dungeon as they did before. Sometimes you might find a good reason to return to an old dungeon!
entries/basic_portals.json::/pages/0/tex: First, here is a minimum raw materials list: $(li)9x Stone Bricks$(li)3x Chiseled Stone Bricks$(li)24x Gold Ingots$(li)1x Trapped Chest$(li)1x Eye of Ender$(br)You can also use cracked or mossy stone bricks.$(br2)Keep in mind you will also need to craft and activate keys. Building the portal frame is only the first step.
entries/basic_portals.json::/pages/1/tex: First craft three gilded portal blocks
entries/basic_portals.json::/pages/2/tex: Then use one to craft a portal keyhole block
entries/basic_portals.json::/pages/3/tex: Then create a portal like this.
entries/basic_portals.json::/pages/4/tex: Decorating the portal is highly encouraged! Also any air blocks except the two in the middle where the portal forms can be filled with whatever blocks you like. Sinking the portal one block into the ground or building steps up to it might be a good idea too.
entries/introduction.json::/pages/0/text: Dimensional Dungeons adds nearly limitless procedurally generated dungeons to Minecraft! These dungeons are all placed in a single, separate dimension which can be accessed from a portal anywhere on the Overworld. This makes the dungeons themselves renewable and it provides challenging and replayable adventure-like maps.
entries/introduction.json::/pages/1/text: The dungeon dimension limits building and block breaking. Obstacle courses can't be bridged over. Combat can't be trivialized by building fences around mobs. And light and darkness matter when you can't place torches! Also, no stealing the blocks. (Unless you turn off the block protection in the server config.)
entries/introduction.json::/pages/2/text: Besides challenges in room design the dungeons are also randomly populated with enemies and worthwhile loot! Many rooms with valuable treasure chests require solving a puzzle that will test your knowledge of Minecraft game mechanics.
entries/introduction.json::/pages/3/text: To enter the dungeon dimension you will need a portal frame and at least one activated portal key. This book contains guided chapters on both topics.
entries/patch_notes_152.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Changed dungeon generation to occur in smaller steps over multiple ticks.$(li)Added sound effects and particles to the keyhole to let you know that it is working.$(li)Fixed multiple bugs related to advancements.
entries/patch_notes_152.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Added a ceiling to the sandy theme and made changes to a few rooms.$(li)Fixed an armor stand bug in one of the advice rooms.$(li)Fixed a certain jailed villager's trades.$(li)Changed the mod version numbers to be less confusing with Minecraft version numbers.
entries/patch_notes_154.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Greatly improved the speed of dungeon building!$(li)Almost completely eliminated the lag spike that occurs when a new dungeon is built.$(li)Fixed a major oversight involving breaking the Keyhole block while a build is in progress.
entries/patch_notes_154.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Portals will once again refuse to open if they lead to a void.$(li)Increased the default build speed from 2 ticks skipped per chunk, to 5.$(li)Therefore, check your server config if you're still experiencing lag.$(li)Portals will now open faster if the dungeon is already built.
entries/patch_notes_160.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Added $(bold)Blank Advanced Keys$() and $(bold)Blank Theme Keys$() for modpack makers!$(li)Added custom JEI support.$(li)Fixed a bug with the roofs of large rooms being drawn incorrectly.
entries/patch_notes_160.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Breaking and placing blocks no longer flickers for a frame.$(li)Eating Chorus Fruit is now handled a little better.
entries/patch_notes_164.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Added $(bold)Personal Dimension Keys$()! $(li)Personal Dimension Keys are craftable as soon as you craft your first key and keyhole. $(li)Personal Dimension Keys will 'bind' to the player that activates them, and all keys activated by the same player will lead to the same place.
entries/patch_notes_164.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Added $(bold)Teleporter Hub Keys$()! $(li)Teleporter Hub Keys can be found in advanced dungeons. $(li)Exiting a portal in any dimension now causes you to face away from that portal.
entries/patch_notes_166.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Changed the cheat structure to be "/dimdungeons <cheats>" with all of my cheats under one global cheat. $(li)Added a new cheat: /dimdungeons givepersonal [recipient] [whose_key] $(li)Bugfix for dungeons not completely generating if the server is closed during generation.
entries/patch_notes_166.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Bugfix for players occasionally obtaining other player's personal dimension keys. $(li)Bugfix for a rare crash or portal failure that could occur when ticking the keyhole after a dungeon is finished being built.
entries/patch_notes_168.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Implemented a new config option for damage scaling. This option will multiply the damage dealt to players (before armor) from all sources in a basic or advanced dungeon. Defaults to 1.0x and 1.5x. $(li)Implemented a way to limit who can enter your personal dimension. For more information see that section of this book.
entries/patch_notes_168.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Mobs whose names fail to translate will not be nametagged. $(li)Fixed a crash when a vanilla mob fails to spawn. (Such as being prevented by Bad Mobs.) $(li)Removed the lag machines in two infamous rooms. $(li)Fixed a bug that prevented hardcore mode from working in the 1.18 and 1.19 ports.
entries/patch_notes_172.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Updated the Chinese translation thanks to Nageih and Dolosaber. $(li)Added a new Russian translation from George-bruh. $(li)Portals to Teleporter Hubs now close on both sides when removing the key. (This only applies to portals 2-8. The first/Oak portal is permanent to prevent anyone from becoming trapped.)
entries/patch_notes_172.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Added a new /dimdungeons getroom cheat to print the name of the room you are in. $(li)Fixed a bug that would cause the friendlist/banlist to fail if another mod used mixins to alter the player's name. (Specifically, Apotheosis.) $(li)Activating keys now correctly returns SUCCESS instead of PASS. This should fix the last of the bugs with keys staying permanently blank.
entries/patch_notes_177.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Added two new tower rooms. $(li)Theme keys now appear in advanced tier dungeons. $(li)New data blocks for custom room builders.
entries/patch_notes_178.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Major room refresh! Functional and aesthetic changes for over 50 rooms! $(li)Added config options to disable each dimension. $(li)Removed the locked chests added in the previous version.
entries/patch_notes_179.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Creative Mode players now bypass block protection. $(li)Updated the Chinese translation, thank you to DoloC8! $(li)Updated the Russian translation, thank you to George-bruh! $(li)Yet more room bugfixes.
entries/patch_notes_190.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Loot tables have been updated with popular items. $(li)Each theme now has custom graphics for each key! $(li)Added a config feature to prevent blocks from dropping items. $(li)Added 12 new rooms!
entries/patch_notes_190.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Added natural skylight to the personal build dimension. $(li)Reverted the ambient light in the dungeon dimension. Rooms will now appear intentionally dark! $(li)Changed the recipe for the personal dimension key.
entries/patch_notes_194.json::/pages/0/t: $(li)Hardcore portals have a new option to include all players in a radius. $(li)Interacting with keyholes no longer behaves strangely when your offhand is not empty. $(li)Revived the locked chests feature!
entries/patch_notes_194.json::/pages/1/t: $(li)Added a new block tag for activating keys. $(li)Bugfix for a crash in Debug Worlds.
entries/patch_notes_1_10.json::/pages/0/: $(li)Endermen and Shulkers can no longer teleport inside dungeons.$(li)Players can no longer use Chorus Fruit to teleport inside dungeons.$(li)Added the Bell of Secrets, which can help reveal hidden treasures! It can be found in chests.
entries/patch_notes_1_10.json::/pages/1/: $(li)New /givekey cheat that accepts multiple parameters.$(li)Revised loot table functionality and contents.$(li)Many new rooms added and revised.$(li)Basic and advanced tier dungeons now have more unique differences.
entries/patch_notes_1_11.json::/pages/0/: $(li)Added new LARGE rooms to advanced dungeons.$(li)Added other new rooms.$(li)Adjusted the models for both Gold Portal and Portal Crown Blocks.
entries/patch_notes_1_12.json::/pages/0/: $(li)Added the Key Enscribing Station.$(li)Added hardcore mode to the server config.$(li)Added the Homeward Pearl.
entries/patch_notes_1_12.json::/pages/1/: $(li)Various mob stats are now configurable.$(li)Witches and Vindicators now spawn in advanced dungeons! (Configurable.)
entries/patch_notes_1_13.json::/pages/0/: $(li)Over 70 rooms were revised.$(li)Some blocks have new textures by MrDenn.$(li)Portals to dungeons can now be built in any dimension.$(li)Fixed some rooms in which players could get stuck.$(li)Improved the functionality of the Bell of Secrets. (It now works.)
entries/patch_notes_1_13.json::/pages/1/: $(li)Various bugs relating to the worldborder have been fixed.$(li)New themed dungeons!$(li)Enemies will randomly carry keys to themed dungeons.$(li)Made the pickaxe the official tool for all blocks in this mod.
entries/patch_notes_1_14.json::/pages/0/: $(li)Added a second themed dungeon with a sandy theme.
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/0/: Now that you're comfortable in your own personal pocket dimension it is time to learn about setting limits on who can follow you through your portal. Configuring access to your dimension is done from the inside by using one of five items on the gold portal by the entrance. (The items are never consumed.) Those items will be covered on the next five pages.
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/1/: Using a Book on your portal will speak to you your current guest list, as well as if that list is currently operating in whitelist mode or blacklist mode.
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/2/: Using White Dye on your portal will switch it into whitelist mode. The list of configured names will be treated as friends and no one else will be allowed in.
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/3/: Using Black Dye on your portal will switch it into blacklist mode. The list of configured names will be treated as a banlist and everyone EXCEPT the named players will be allowed in.
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/4/: First name the Paper on an Anvil with the name of another player. Then use the paper on your portal to add them to the flexible guest list. Use the Paper again to remove that player's name. The list can be a whitelist or a blacklist.
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/5/: Using a Grindstone on your portal will clear all names configured on it.
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/6/: There are several limitations to this security system. First and most importantly it only controls who can enter. There are no build permissions implemented. (Although some servers may implement this separately.) Second, there are a number of ways that players can by bypass the permissions and gain entry regardless of how a portal is configured:
entries/personal_portals.json::/pages/7/: $(li)A dimension's owner is always allowed in. $(li)Players in creative mode are always allowed in. $(li)The server admin can set disablePersonalDimSecurity= true in the server config. $(li)The permissions are only checked by a normal portal with a keyhole. Using other means to teleport within will bypass the checks.
entries/simple_advice.json::/pages/0/tex: $(li)While most puzzles do not require an Ender Pearl, they are often the easiest solution.$(li)There are literal advice dispensers around the dungeon. Heed them!$(li)Keys can be renamed on an anvil without changing their function or status.$(li)Mobs will not spawn in dungeons, except near spawners.
entries/simple_advice.json::/pages/1/tex: $(li)If you are using a gravestones-type of mod then be sure to configure the server's whitelist so that you can break that block.$(li)Even though some of the traps are cruel, I really $(l)do$() want you to succeed!$(li)Up Up Down Down Left Right Left Right$(li)Cracked bricks are a huge tell.$(li)Using a vanilla map is much more fun than using a minimap.
entries/simple_advice.json::/pages/2/tex: $(li)These dungeons exist in extra-dimensional pocket space! So it's possible that loot from $(o)other dimensions$() has ended up here as well.$(li)I care about your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports! You can contact the mod author through curseforge, github, or Discord.$(li)Some dungeon rooms assume default game rules, such as doFireTick=true.
entries/simple_advice.json::/pages/3/tex: $(li)Save your keys! At least until you're sure you've found everything in a dungeon.$(li)Potions of Luck can be used to upgrade the quality of loot in 'easy' chests.$(li)Thank You For Playing
